title: AS2: try-finally (no catch) corrupts finally body — missing null byte for catch_var field
description: When compiling 'try { } finally { ... }' with no catch block, the compiler emits no bytes for the catch variable name field. But Ruffle's read_try() in swf/src/avm1/read.rs unconditionally calls read_str() for catch_var regardless of whether HasCatchBlock is set (line 370-374). With no catch-name bytes emitted, read_str() consumes bytes from the TryBody, corrupting the finally body. Fix: always emit at least a null byte (0x00) for the catch variable field when !hasCatch — i.e. catchNameFieldLen should be 1 (not 0) and payloadLen must account for it. Location: packages/core/src/as2/compiler.ts around lines 1155-1180 in the ActionTry emission section.
